findings.motion: Assembly Elections Committee, AB 25 (DeMaio), motion 'Do pass and be re-referred to the Committee on [Judiciary]', failed
findings.note: AB 25 would require documentary proof of citizenship with a voter registration, require elections officials to count all ballots within 72 hours, and repeal the state rule that bars local voter-ID requirements. The bill page's vote record for the committee hearing on 2025-04-09 lists Stefani among the NO votes on the do-pass motion.

findings.motion: Assembly Elections Committee, AB 25 (DeMaio), motion for reconsideration, failed
findings.note: On the same day, on the motion to reconsider AB 25, the bill page's vote record lists Stefani among the NO votes.

findings.passage: “The bill weaponizes voter suppression,” said Assemblywoman Catherine Stefani (D-San Francisco). “The 72 hour deadline is rushing the process.”
findings.note: Quoted by the California Globe in its report on the AB 25 committee hearing; she describes the bill and its 72-hour ballot-count deadline.
